# PDFCOFFEE.COM

> > PDFCOFFEE.COM is an unlimited document upload and sharing platform supporting PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files with social authentication and content discovery features.

PDFCOFFEE.COM provides a centralized repository for document sharing and discovery across educational, professional, and entertainment content. The platform supports unlimited file uploads, social login integration, and curated content collections for users to explore trending and best-rated documents.

## Key Topics

- PDF download
- Document upload
- Unlimited storage
- Document sharing
- PDF sharing
- Social login
- Authentication
- Educational resources
- Content publishing
- User account
- Document repository
- File conversion
- Educational library
- Microsoft Word
- PowerPoint

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://pdfcoffee.com): PDFCOFFEE.COM homepage with unlimited PDF, Word, and PowerPoint upload and sharing capabilities.
- [Login & Authentication](https://pdfcoffee.com/publish): User login and authentication with Google and Facebook social login integration.
- [My Documents](https://pdfcoffee.com/documents): User account dashboard for managing uploaded documents and account settings.

## Content Discovery

- [Top Stories](https://pdfcoffee.com/top-stories): Trending and most-viewed documents on the PDFCOFFEE.COM platform.
- [Best Stories](https://pdfcoffee.com/best-stories): Curated collection of highly-rated and best-performing documents in the library.

## Document Library

- [Psicología Oscura - Steven Turner](https://pdfcoffee.com/psicologia-oscura-steven-turner-2019pdf-4-pdf-free.html): Dark Psychology by Steven Turner: psychological analysis and behavioral studies PDF.
- [R S Aggarwal - Quantitative Aptitude](https://pdfcoffee.com/r-s-aggarwal-quantitative-aptitudepdf-pdf-free.html): Quantitative Aptitude by R S Aggarwal: competitive exam preparation and mathematics PDF.
- [Genki Textbook 1 - 3rd Edition](https://pdfcoffee.com/genki-textbook-1-3rd-edition-3-pdf-free.html): Genki Japanese language learning textbook for beginners and intermediate learners.
- [Atomic Habits (Indonesian Translation)](https://pdfcoffee.com/atomic-habits-versi-indonesiajames-cleartagt-pdf-free.html): Atomic Habits by James Clear: self-help and habit-building guide in Indonesian language.
- [IA 3 VALIX BOOK](https://pdfcoffee.com/ia-3-valix-bookpdf-pdf-free.html): Intermediate Accounting textbook for accounting education and professional development.
- [La Théorie de l'Attachement](https://pdfcoffee.com/la-theorie-de-l-attachement-est-un-modele-10-pages-37-ko-pdf-free.html): Attachment Theory academic paper in French covering psychological development models.
